note: WAEC Physics round 6 (R33 top-up): principle of moments; terminal velocity of the raindrop; the orbiting astronaut in free fall; the relative density bottle; the hydrometer; upthrust as displaced weight; capillarity; viscosity; the jar lid over hot water; resonance of matching forks; free electrons carrying heat; the dull black radiator; the pot's convection; frequency unchanged between media; the eclipse geometry; the ray along the normal; two mirrors at ninety degrees giving three images; the magnifying glass; the umbra; the 25 cm near point; terminal p.d. below e.m.f.; e.m.f. as energy per coulomb; the filament's wasted heat; the balance losing 2 N to upthrust; why transformers refuse d.c.; the electric bell's make-and-break; beta raising the atomic number; nucleons giving the mass number; fission raising steam for turbines; 30 km/h average; the speedometer's instantaneous reading; repetition against random error; gravity holding the atmosphere; the manometer; the longer spanner's moment.
